pricebook_items_money_check.name: pricebook_items_money_check
pricebook_items_money_check.value: "pricebook_items"."price_cents" >= 0 and "pricebook_items"."cost_cents" >= 0 and "pricebook_items"."spiff_cents" >= 0 and ("pricebook_items"."member_price_cents" is null or "pricebook_items"."member_price_cents" >= 0)

system_of_record_target_check.name: system_of_record_target_check
system_of_record_target_check.value: ("system_of_record"."scope" = 'business_unit' and "system_of_record"."business_unit_id" is not null and "system_of_record"."user_id" is null) or ("system_of_record"."scope" = 'user' and "system_of_record"."user_id" is not null and "system_of_record"."business_unit_id" is null)
